electricity_disconnect.title: Electricity Bill & Urgent Power Disconnection Threat

seg_consumer_greeting.text: Dear Consumer, your electricity power supply will be disconnected tonight at 9:30 PM from the local power sub-station because your previous month bill was not updated.

seg_threat_deadline.text: Power will be cut in 75 minutes unless verified immediately.
seg_threat_deadline.flagExplanation: Scammers deliberately threaten shut-offs after 7 PM when legitimate utility offices and physical payment counters are closed, causing panic so you do not verify.
seg_threat_deadline.flagHowToVerify: State discoms never disconnect residential power at night without issuing formal printed notices weeks in advance.

seg_officer_phone.text: Please contact our power officer immediately at 98765-43210.
seg_officer_phone.flagExplanation: Legitimate power utilities use centralized helpline numbers (such as 1912), never random personal mobile numbers.
seg_officer_phone.flagHowToVerify: Never dial numbers sent in SMS messages. Look up the official customer care number on your physical paper electricity bill.

seg_fake_bill_link.text: Or update KYC online at https://urjavidyut-bill-update.fictional to avoid immediate blackout.
seg_fake_bill_link.flagExplanation: The link uses an unofficial domain designed to look real, which will download a remote-access app or steal your net banking login.
seg_fake_bill_link.flagHowToVerify: Utility payments should only be made through the state government utility portal or authorized bank applications.

simulation.prompt: You receive this SMS at 8:15 PM while your family is watching TV. What is your immediate next step?

opt_call_officer.label: Call the 10-digit number immediately to stop the power cut
opt_call_officer.feedbackTitle: Danger: You are speaking directly with the scammer
opt_call_officer.feedbackExplanation: The person answering will pretend to be an officer and urge you to install an app (like a screen-sharing tool) to 'update the bill', which drains your bank account.
opt_call_officer.goldenRule: Never call phone numbers received in threatening text messages.

opt_click_link.label: Click the link and pay ₹10 to check if the bill updates
opt_click_link.feedbackTitle: Danger: Phishing or Remote Access Trojan
opt_click_link.feedbackExplanation: The page steals debit card details or downloads an APK that reads your OTPs secretly.
opt_click_link.goldenRule: Never enter banking details or download apps from SMS links.

opt_verify_utility.label: Open your official electricity provider app or wait till morning to check your account
opt_verify_utility.feedbackExplanation: Checking your account balance through your official utility portal or calling 1912 confirms whether any genuine bill is pending.
opt_verify_utility.goldenRule: Always verify utility claims through independent, official sources.

courier_redelivery.title: Parcel Failed Delivery / ₹5 Address Update Scam

seg_courier_greeting.text: Consignment ID QTK-98214 could not be delivered to your address.

seg_delivery_failed_notice.text: Delivery failed: Recipient house number or street name is missing from shipping label.
seg_delivery_failed_notice.flagExplanation: Scammers send millions of these messages knowing that many people are expecting packages from e-commerce sites.
seg_delivery_failed_notice.flagHowToVerify: Check the orders section in the exact app where you placed your order, rather than trusting an unverified SMS.

seg_reschedule_deadline.text: Your package will be returned to sender or destroyed within 24 hours.
seg_reschedule_deadline.flagExplanation: Threatening to return or destroy your parcel pressures you to act quickly without thinking.
seg_reschedule_deadline.flagHowToVerify: Couriers hold parcels at local hubs for several days and make multiple delivery attempts.

seg_fake_portal_link.text: Update your address & pay ₹5 rescheduling fee at https://quicktrack-redelivery.fictional.
seg_fake_portal_link.flagExplanation: The nominal ₹5 fee is a psychological trap. You feel safe paying such a small amount, but the fake payment gateway captures your full card number, expiry, and CVV.
seg_fake_portal_link.flagHowToVerify: Legitimate couriers never demand online re-delivery fees via SMS links.

simulation.prompt: You recently ordered items online and received this SMS. How do you respond?

opt_pay_fee_link.label: Click the link and pay ₹5 on the card page to get your parcel
opt_pay_fee_link.feedbackTitle: Danger: Your card credentials are stolen
opt_pay_fee_link.feedbackExplanation: The fake gateway captures your card details. Scammers immediately attempt large fraudulent transactions while prompting you for OTPs.
opt_pay_fee_link.goldenRule: Never pay re-delivery fees via SMS links.

opt_call_courier_number.label: Call the sender number from the SMS
opt_call_courier_number.feedbackExplanation: The caller will ask you to install a 'courier helper app' (APK) that forwards SMS messages to their server.
opt_call_courier_number.goldenRule: Never call unknown phone numbers found in delivery SMS messages.

opt_check_official_merchant.label: Open the e-commerce app where you bought the item to check tracking status
opt_check_official_merchant.feedbackExplanation: Checking your official order page proves whether the courier actually attempted delivery or if this message was random spam.
opt_check_official_merchant.goldenRule: Always check delivery status inside your original shopping app.

upi_collect_request.title: Fake Refund / UPI Reverse Payment Collect Request

seg_upi_collect_header.text: Payment Request from Shree Retailers (Fictional Merchant).

seg_payer_note.text: Note from requester: 'Refund of excess payment. Enter UPI PIN to accept refund into your bank account.'
seg_payer_note.flagExplanation: You NEVER enter a UPI PIN to receive money or refunds. UPI PIN is exclusively used to authorize deductions from your account.
seg_payer_note.flagHowToVerify: Whenever money is credited to your bank account via UPI, it arrives automatically without any PIN or action required on your phone.

seg_pin_demand_prompt.text: Tap 'Pay' and enter UPI PIN to claim ₹14,200 instantly.
seg_pin_demand_prompt.flagExplanation: This is a Collect Request (debit), not a credit. Entering your PIN transfers ₹14,200 immediately to the scammer's bank account.
seg_pin_demand_prompt.flagHowToVerify: Read the button carefully: If it says 'Pay' or asks for a PIN, money will LEAVE your account.

seg_bank_warning_footer.text: Standard NPCI / Bank warning: Entering PIN will debit money from your account.

simulation.prompt: A seller claims they accidentally overcharged you and sent this UPI request to return your money. What do you do?

opt_enter_upi_pin.label: Click Pay and enter your 4-digit UPI PIN to claim the ₹14,200 refund
opt_enter_upi_pin.feedbackTitle: Catastrophic: ₹14,200 instantly debited from your account
opt_enter_upi_pin.feedbackExplanation: Entering your PIN authorized the transfer of ₹14,200 out of your account. UPI transactions cannot be reversed once authorized.
opt_enter_upi_pin.goldenRule: You never enter a UPI PIN to receive money. UPI PIN is only for sending money.

opt_decline_and_block.label: Decline the request, report the VPA handle, and block the requester
opt_decline_and_block.feedbackExplanation: Declining the collect request prevents any money from leaving your account. Reporting the VPA alerts the payment app.
opt_decline_and_block.goldenRule: Reject any collect request that claims to be a refund or prize.

opt_chat_seller.label: Message the seller to ask why it says Pay instead of Receive
opt_chat_seller.feedbackTitle: Caution: Scammers will use social engineering
opt_chat_seller.feedbackExplanation: The scammer will reassure you with technical jargon ('The system requires authorization before credit'). Never negotiate.
opt_chat_seller.goldenRule: Do not argue with scammers; reject and report immediately.

digital_arrest_notice.title: Digital Arrest / Fake Law Enforcement Video Call Notice

seg_official_seal_header.text: National Security Investigation Notice — High Priority Case #ND-8831.

seg_arrest_warrant_claim.text: An arrest warrant has been issued in your name for illegal SIM cards linked to money laundering.
seg_arrest_warrant_claim.flagTitle: Fabricated Arrest Warrant Over Messaging Apps
seg_arrest_warrant_claim.flagExplanation: Law enforcement agencies, police, CBI, or telecom authorities NEVER issue arrest warrants or conduct investigations over WhatsApp or Skype.
seg_arrest_warrant_claim.flagHowToVerify: Legitimate police investigations follow formal legal procedures with in-person notices, not video calls.

seg_secrecy_order.text: You are placed under immediate 'Digital Arrest'. You are legally forbidden from telling family members or consulting a lawyer.
seg_secrecy_order.flagExplanation: There is NO legal concept of 'Digital Arrest' under Indian law. It is an entirely manufactured phrase used by criminal syndicates.
seg_secrecy_order.flagHowToVerify: Indian law requires physical presence, legal representation, and judicial magistrates. No law permits virtual custody.

seg_camera_continuous_demand.text: Keep your camera switched on 24x7 without disconnecting, or police teams will be dispatched to your home.
seg_camera_continuous_demand.flagExplanation: Demanding that you keep your camera on isolates you from loved ones and prevents you from making phone calls to verify the claim.
seg_camera_continuous_demand.flagHowToVerify: Disconnect immediately. No legitimate officer can compel you to remain on a personal video call.

seg_clearance_deposit_prompt.text: Transfer your bank balances to the Supreme Court Security Clearance Account for temporary audit.
seg_clearance_deposit_prompt.flagExplanation: No court, police department, or government agency ever asks citizens to transfer funds to any 'verification account'.
seg_clearance_deposit_prompt.flagHowToVerify: Never transfer money to any account for 'clearance' or 'verification'.

simulation.prompt: A caller dressed in a police uniform on video call claims an arrest warrant is pending against you and orders you to stay on camera. What do you do?

opt_obey_video_transfer.label: Stay on camera and transfer your savings to the 'clearance account' to prove innocence
opt_obey_video_transfer.feedbackTitle: Catastrophic: Lifelong savings lost to extortion syndicates
opt_obey_video_transfer.feedbackExplanation: The criminals will continue demanding money until you have no funds left. Once transferred, recovering money is extremely difficult.
opt_obey_video_transfer.goldenRule: Government agencies never ask for funds into 'verification accounts'.

opt_disconnect_call_112.label: Disconnect the video call immediately, notify your family, and call 112 / 1930
opt_disconnect_call_112.feedbackExplanation: Disconnecting breaks the psychological trance. Calling 112 connects you with real police, who will confirm the call was a fraud.
opt_disconnect_call_112.goldenRule: 'Digital Arrest' is completely fake. Disconnect immediately.

opt_ask_for_id_card.label: Ask the caller to hold up their police ID card to the webcam
opt_ask_for_id_card.feedbackTitle: Caution: Criminals use forged badges and fake police stations
opt_ask_for_id_card.feedbackExplanation: Scammers have realistic fake police uniforms, forged ID cards, and studio backdrops with official emblems.
opt_ask_for_id_card.goldenRule: Do not evaluate credentials shown on video calls. Disconnect.

q_electricity_sms.message: Power will be cut at 9:30 PM tonight due to pending bill. Call 98765-43210 immediately to pay.
q_electricity_sms.question: What is the primary indicator that this message is fraudulent?

opt_a.text: The message was sent in English rather than the state language
opt_a.explanation: Utility messages can be sent in English or regional languages; this is not the main red flag.

opt_b.text: The bill amount was not specified in the text
opt_b.explanation: While bill amounts are usually specified, this is secondary.

opt_c.text: Threatening a night-time power cut and giving a personal 10-digit mobile number
opt_c.explanation: State power companies do not cut power at night without written notice, and they never use personal 10-digit mobile numbers as helplines.

opt_d.text: The message lacks an official logo image
opt_d.explanation: SMS messages cannot contain embedded logos.

q_electricity_sms.goldenRule: Utility companies use official toll-free helplines (like 1912), never personal 10-digit phone numbers.

q_courier_sms.message: Your package IND98124 could not be delivered due to wrong address. Update address & pay ₹5: https://courier-update.fictional
q_courier_sms.question: Why do scammers ask for a tiny payment of just ₹5?

opt_a.text: Because they only want ₹5 from millions of victims
opt_a.explanation: The ₹5 is not their real target; their target is your full bank account.

opt_b.text: The tiny fee feels harmless, but the fake payment gateway steals your complete card details and OTP
opt_b.explanation: You let down your guard for ₹5, but entering your card credentials allows scammers to steal thousands.

opt_c.text: Because ₹5 is the legal government parcel re-delivery charge
opt_c.explanation: Couriers do not charge ₹5 via SMS links.

opt_d.text: To verify that your mobile number has active SMS balance
opt_d.explanation: SMS balance is irrelevant to the scam mechanism.

q_courier_sms.goldenRule: Never enter banking or card details on links received via unsolicited SMS messages.

q_upi_collect.message: Payment Request for ₹8,500 from Buyer. Note: Enter UPI PIN to claim your refund.
q_upi_collect.question: When do you ever need to enter your UPI PIN to RECEIVE money into your bank account?

opt_a.text: Only when receiving money from a new contact for the first time
opt_a.explanation: You NEVER enter a PIN to receive money, even from new contacts.

opt_b.text: Only when accepting refunds from merchants or online platforms
opt_b.explanation: Refunds arrive automatically without requiring any PIN.

opt_c.text: Only when the transaction amount is greater than ₹5,000
opt_c.explanation: The transaction amount does not change UPI mechanics.

opt_d.text: NEVER. UPI PIN is exclusively used to SEND money or debit your account
opt_d.explanation: Money arrives in your account automatically. Entering your PIN always sends money OUT.

q_upi_collect.goldenRule: UPI PIN is ONLY for sending money. Receiving money NEVER requires a PIN.

q_digital_arrest.sender: Video Call claiming to be Police / Cyber Cell
q_digital_arrest.message: You are placed under 'Digital Arrest' for money laundering. You must remain on camera 24x7 and transfer money to an audit account.
q_digital_arrest.question: What is the legal reality of 'Digital Arrest' under Indian criminal law?

opt_a.text: 'Digital Arrest' does NOT exist in Indian law. Police and courts never interrogate citizens or demand money via video calls
opt_a.explanation: Under Indian law, arrests and investigations require physical legal procedures. 'Digital Arrest' is a complete fabrication.

opt_b.text: It is a new legal provision introduced for cyber crime investigations
opt_b.explanation: There is no such legal provision. The Ministry of Home Affairs has explicitly warned against this fake concept.

opt_c.text: It is legal only if the caller wears an official police uniform
opt_c.explanation: Criminals regularly wear counterfeit uniforms and use fake backdrops.

opt_d.text: It is valid if they display a stamped court order on screen
opt_d.explanation: Scammers easily forge letters with fake seals and logos.

q_digital_arrest.goldenRule: There is no such thing as 'Digital Arrest'. Disconnect video calls immediately and call 1930 / 112.
